summary: Cover G₁(𝔰) by the shells of positions of the gauges of sizes T_i = tL^{11(ϱ+1)i}; on each shell apply lintegral_positions_le with the majorant bound of formMajorant_sq_le (capped volumes from hasMatSize_sub_one_of_floorValues), and sum the geometric series.

steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨l, _, _⟩ : 2 ≤ L ∧ 1 ≤ ρ ∧ 1 ≤ L, c, _, ⟨_, _⟩, -, N, -⟩ := by bound [hF.ten_le],
    hF.isCut_complexLevel, one_le_two.trans two_le_pi, hF.haarRatio_spec
steps.claim: 2 ≤ L, 1 ≤ ρ, 1 ≤ L; F is cut (c); π ≥ 1; the facts on λ_hF (N).

steps.lean: let T i := t * L ^ (11 * 𝔰.n * i)

have o i a b (h : a ≤ 11 * 𝔰.n * i * b := by lia) : L ^ a ≤ T i ^ b := by
    grw [h, pow_mul, ← one_mul (L ^ _), ht]
have g i b := hL.trans (pow_one L ▸ o (.succ i) 1 (.succ b))
steps.claim: g: the gauges of size T(i+1)^{…} exist (ρ ≤ T(i+1)^b).

steps.lean:
grw [← mul_one (ENNReal.ofReal _), ← setLIntegral_univ, ← Set.iUnion_eq_univ_iff (f := fun i ↦
    (hF.gauge (g i (99 * 𝔰.ϱ + 98))).positionsOfSize).2 fun x ↦
    (pow_unbounded_of_one_lt _ (by linarith)).imp
    fun i e ↦ ⟨⟨⟩, fun _ _ ↦ (norm_apply_le_l2_opNorm ..).trans (e.le.trans ((o _ i _).trans_eq
    (pow_mul ..)))⟩, ← iUnion_disjointed, lintegral_iUnion_le, ← tsum_two_zpow_neg_add_one]
steps.claim: Every x lies in positionsOfSize of some gauge(hF, g(i, 99ϱ+98)) (its matrix entries are bounded by a power of T(i)); write the integral over G₁(𝔰) as a sum over the disjointed shells and use Σ 2^{−(i+1)} = 1 to distribute.

steps.lean:
simp [← ENNReal.tsum_mul_left, disjointed]; gcongr 1 with i; grw [lintegral_positions_le _ _ c hW
    hj hq (Θ := .ofReal ε * (hF.haarRatio * card I) ^ 2) ?_ sdiff_le (e := .ofReal
    ((π * ρ ^ 24) ^ 𝔰.k * ρ ^ (9999 * 𝔰.n) / T i ^ s)) fun x m ↦ ?_]
steps.claim: On shell i apply lintegral_positions_le (for the two gauges, with Θ = ε(λ_hF|I|)², the head q, S = the shell and e = (πρ²⁴)^kρ^{9999(ϱ+1)}/T(i)^s), leaving the pairing-norm bound and the pointwise bound.

steps.lean:
have := @toReal_ne_zero
  simp (disch := finiteness) [RealPlaceSizes.gauge, floorModulus, ← toReal_le_toReal,
    *, T, formConst, bandConst, volU, field,
    mul_pow, ← pow_mul, abs_of_nonneg, ENNReal.zpow_sub, ENNReal.zpow_neg]
steps.claim: Unfold the constants (gauge, floorModulus, formConst, bandConst, volU) as real numbers.

steps.lean: nth_grw 1 [tsub_le_self, l, l, hL, ← hF.mul_cube_lt_s]; ring_nf; gcongr <;> omega
steps.claim: Compare the exponents (s > 10⁹(ϱ+1)³, L ≥ 2, ρ ≤ L).

steps.lean:
repeat grw [Level.pairingNorm, (ofReal_norm _).ge, norm_inner_le_norm]
  simp +contextual [mul_pow, lintegral_mul_const, N, hW.2, c.law, -upperMeasure, enorm_smul,
    ← ofReal_norm (wave _), hW.stronglyMeasurable.enorm.pow, c.stronglyMeasurable.enorm.pow]
steps.claim: The pairing norms: |⟨F(x), W(y)⟩| ≤ |F(x)||W(y)| and the Bessel laws make the integrals over θ functions on 𝖴∖G₁(𝔰) (N).
If i = 0 and t > 1, the pointwise bound is h.

steps.lean:
grw [hf x, formMajorant_sq_le _ c hW hj hp ⟨⟩
    (by grw [hF.gauge.floorMassLe_one ⟨j, by lia⟩ hasFibreBound_floorQuadric ·, volume_le]) (σ :=
    volume (Metric.ball (0 : ℂ) (T i)⁻¹)) (by bound) hs fun z _ a b d ↦ ?_, hF.volumeExponent_eq]
steps.claim: Otherwise f ≤ formMajorant and formMajorant_sq_le with V from floorMassLe_one (and volume_le) and the cap σ = vol(ball(0, T(i)⁻¹)), the capped condition to be shown (step 14); volumeExponent = s.

steps.lean:
gcongr; simp (disch := finiteness) [RealPlaceSizes.gauge,
    ← toReal_le_toReal]; ring_nf; gcongr <;> grind [RealPlaceSizes]
steps.claim: The constants of the gauge combine.

steps.lean: cases i; simp_all [T, ht.antisymm', ← NNReal.coe_lt_one, not_lt_of_ge]
steps.claim: For i = 0 with t ≤ 1 the cap holds trivially (T(0) = t = 1).
Contrapositive: if no floor value is capped, x is not in the shell.

steps.lean:
simpa using fun _ ↦ ⟨_, le_rfl, ⟨⟩, by simpa [RealPlaceSizes.gauge, HasMatSize] using!
    ((hF.gauge (g _ 0)).hasMatSize_sub_one_of_floorValues _ hj hp hq (by
    simpa [RealPlaceSizes.gauge] using fun _ _ ↦
      (o _ _ 1).trans') ((c.2 (by aesop)).imp fun u ⟨h, j⟩ ↦ ⟨h, (c.2 (by aesop)).imp fun v ⟨k, l⟩ ↦
    ⟨k, j, l, by simpa using (hasMatSize_box _ l).sub (hasMatSize_box _ j)⟩⟩)
    b d fun a h ↦ (Set.not_subset.1 (m ⟨a, h, measure_mono ·⟩)).elim fun c ⟨d, r⟩ ↦ ⟨.mk0 c
    (r <| by simp [·]; bound), d, by simp [RealPlaceSizes.gauge] at r ⊢; grw [← r, inv_inv]⟩)⟩
steps.claim: Then each floor a ≥ j holds a unit c with |c| ≥ T(i)⁻¹ in floorValues, so c⁻¹ has size ≤ …, and hasMatSize_sub_one_of_floorValues (for the gauge of size L and the heads p, q, with the box elements from the cut property) shows that x has size 99(ϱ+1) for the gauge of size T(i−1), i.e. x lies in an earlier shell.
